name: TOTPVerify
description: Verifies a TOTP code against a shared secret (RFC 6238). Supports configurable time window for clock skew tolerance.
syntax: TOTPVerify( string secret, string code, [struct options] )

params.name: code
params.description: The TOTP code to verify (typically 6 digits)

params.name: options
params.description: Optional struct: window (default 1), digits (default 6), period (default 30), algorithm (SHA1|SHA256|SHA512, default SHA1)
